sample_unit: ratings (10 ChatGPT responses rated by 22 obstetrics and gynecology specialists)

links.outcome: Whether clinician reviewers detect an intentionally incorrect ChatGPT response
links.effect: The intentionally incorrect response was correctly identified as inaccurate and/or unsafe by 20 of 22 raters (90.9%).
links.quote: The intentionally incorrect response was correctly identified as inaccurate and/or unsafe by 20 of 22 raters (90.9%).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-generated responses to female sexual dysfunction questions via an expert clinician panel measuring accuracy, comprehensiveness, and safety, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
